description:
Configure the Chart of Accounts for Northwind Traders to better organize expenses. 

1. Navigate to Settings > Chart of Accounts.
2. Create a New Group named 'Facility Costs' under the Expenses section.
3. Create two New Accounts inside this 'Facility Costs' group:
   - Name: 'Warehouse Rent'
   - Name: 'Shop Electricity'

Ensure both accounts are explicitly assigned to the 'Facility Costs' group so they appear nested in financial reports.
